## Goal
After WO-304's refresh, add and plain-word the terms a reader meets in the new help pages and the 0.3.1 app.

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
- Adds short entries (one or two sentences, a 72-year-old reader) for at least: people-search site, listing, "Is this you?" card, practice mode, real requests, requested, confirmed, came back (relisted), Assisted step, credit freeze, Larger text, scheduled check ("Run automatically", `src/freemyid/wizard/dashboard.py:501`), SHA256 check (what it is for, not how to compute it), placeholder (for helpers reading distro notes).
- Each app term quotes the app's label with a citation on the same line.
- Keeps WO-304's entries and order; no entry is removed without a reason in VENDOR_STATUS.md.
- Links only to pages that exist on main (WO-330 links the new pages); `GLOSSARY.md` stays a reachability entry point, so every existing link still resolves.

**Limits (every Grok WO, CLAUDE-G-004):** text only and offline. No network, credentials, git or gh, installs, or running the real app against real sites; never read anything outside the repo. Fake people only (Jane Q Testperson, Springfield IL). Plain words per `docs/POSITIONING.md`: no "guarantee", "erase", "100%" or "nothing is sent"; say "requested" and "confirmed". A real product bug is a file:line finding in VENDOR_STATUS.md (or a strict `xfail` in a test); never edit `src/`. Tests pass on Windows too (`tmp_path`, `pathlib`). Check `tests/copilot/`, `tests/codex/` and `tests/grok/` first; don't duplicate a guard.
